title: Alto, soprano and baritone saxophones in the band
summary: Talk of which saxophones his son, Herbert Trish and Clarence Hall played.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Let's see, your son and Herbert Trist play alto saxophones mostly, huh? Yeah, alto saxophone. And your son's got a soprano sax there, too, huh? Yeah. Uh-huh. Played soprano. You don't see that much anymore. No. No. I think Clarence Hall's still got a soprano, but he doesn't play it. Clarence Hall. Oh, yeah. He doesn't play it much anymore.
He had a, he had a, what did he have? What do you call it, one of those big girls? He had a tenor, he played tenor, I think, Clarence.
He played baritone some now, too.
Yeah, he had baritone, too, I remember, because my son borrowed it from him.
